purpose: Keep a conclusion unchanged even under an imagined condition.
keywords: Even if it rains, we will set off.
Even if others oppose me, I want to decide for myself.
Even if I am alone, I will keep going to the end.
restrictions: The condition may be hypothetical rather than something already true.
mistake: Pair たとえ with a concessive form such as ても, not a plain conditional result.
